record.Title: BSc (Hons) Applied Computing
record.Programme Description: The programme aims to produce graduates with practical knowledge and skills to develop, enhance and maintain computing applications using classic and leading-edge computing concepts and technologies. Areas include Computer and Web Programming, Database Systems, Internet and Communication Technologies, and applications of IT in Health, Finance and Environment.

record.Title: General Documents Required for Mauritian Applicants
record.Description: Applicants are required to upload their: Birth Certificate, Marriage Certificate if applicable, National Identity Card, School Certificate, Higher School Certificate or HSC results, proof of payment of application fees, and a passport-size photo. Applicants holding qualifications other than SC or HSC should also upload the relevant qualifications.
